brief:
Zeteo's founder Mehdi Hasan appeared on Piers Morgan's program to contest Israeli military assertions regarding journalist deaths in Gaza, according to Zeteo. The debate included Netanyahu allies and a former Israeli military spokesperson presenting their account of the casualties.

The discussion centered on the credibility of Israeli military claims about deaths in the territory, with Hasan presenting counterarguments to official Israeli positions on the documented toll.
dek: Zeteo’s founder debates a top Netanyahu ally and a former Israeli military spokesperson about the death toll in Gaza.
title: Mehdi challenges Israeli military claims on Gaza death toll with Piers Morgan
